_doc: Hand-written role of every slice / collection that touched calib documents (mkledger.py joins it with the goldens). role: train (weights fitted to the tokens; never verify for that line), fit-hessian (second-order stats with many parameters per layer), fit-diag (per-row diagonal stats), fit (proxy / knapsack calibration, smooth few-parameter fits), select (accept/reject or best-of picks judged on it), monitor (validation curve, reused often), check (a handful of before/after reads), final (one read of fixed finalists). decisions: rough number of choices judged on it (null = not a decision slice). line: the model line it can bias (all = every quant, including turboderp's). Proxy lines (proxy-2b, proxy-08): Qwen3.5 small-model work on the 4070; they bias only proxy decisions, but method choices made there carry to the 27B. The 0.8B YAQA collection (#33-08) read xcorp, not calib: no ledger line.

@hessians-calib.note: challenge-published input Hessians: sum x x^T over every calib token; every quant (ours, turboderp's) fits to them. Biases all arms alike; absolute KLDs slightly optimistic

@yaqa.note: YAQA collections (rows32, hout32, full32, full64, pilots, noise): first 200 windows of the seed-0 shuffle of 2048-token qad windows (pools.json); YAQA dropped, no shipped quant used them

@headsens.note: headsens.npz qad-pool Fisher diagonal (pools.json qad docs, all positions): ranks the slab head's rows
